about.body: The N20 is BMW's turbocharged 2.0-litre inline-four petrol engine, produced from 2011 to 2017. It was BMW's first mass-market four-cylinder turbocharged engine to feature direct injection and variable valve timing (VANOS), replacing the naturally aspirated N43/N46 family across the range. The N20 is fitted across seven BMW model lines — from the 1 Series up to the 5 Series, plus the X4 and Z4 — making it one of the key engines of BMW's F-generation era.

byModel.body: The N20 powers the 1 Series (F20/F21) across multiple variants from the 116i to 125i. The 2 Series (F22/F23) carries it in the 220i and 225i, while the 3 Series (F30/F31) uses it across the 320i and 328i. The 4 Series (F32/F33/F36) follows with the 420i and 428i, and the 5 Series (F10/F11) takes it in the 520i and 528i. The X4 (F26) and Z4 (E89) complete the N20 application range.

compatibility.body: Because the N20 spans seven different models and multiple body styles, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and drivetrain spec, which we do by registration. A N20 from a 1 Series isn't a drop-in match for a N20 from a 5 Series, even though it's the same base engine code — ancillaries, mounting, and ECU software all differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
